description: This file contains the implementation of the Smarty_Internal_Compile_Include class, which compiles {include} tags in Smarty templates. It handles parsing, caching, scope, and inline compilation of included templates within the Smarty templating engine.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Compile_Include
classes.description: Class responsible for compiling {include} tags in Smarty templates, managing resource parsing, caching, scope, and inline template compilation.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles code for the {include} tag, handling resource parsing, caching, scope, and inline template inclusion.

methods.name: compileInlineTemplate
methods.description: Compiles an inline sub-template, generating PHP code for the inline template source.
